records.question: How many Acropora nana colonies were counted along the Aua Transect in October 1999?
ground_truth_chunks: On 16-IX October 1999, we measured 794 coral colonies and counted macroinvertebrates (in this Case all were echinoderms) in 57X quadrats (0.25 m ) taken at 10 stations along Mayor's 271 m Aua Line.
Along the Aua Transect, 237 of the colonies counted were *Acropora nana.*
